images.name: 달날개와 짧은 갈고리
images.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE newly designed legendary fantasy BOW, alone, from the noble Twilight of the Blue Moon collection. Portrait 1024x1536, 2:3, near-front three-quarter product concept art on uniform very dark midnight-navy background. Exactly one full-length bow and one continuous connected taut string only, with a clearly usable wrapped central handgrip. Preserve the complete top and bottom tips and generous safe framing: all weapon parts inside x=80..944 and y=96..1440, leaving at least 5% clean margin at every edge, no clipped tips. The bow should remain long, graceful, functionally recognizable and exquisitely crafted. CRUCIAL: strong STRUCTURAL ASYMMETRY, not simply different engravings. Upper and lower limbs must visibly differ in length, mass, curve direction, width and silhouette, as precisely described below; the grip may be deliberately offset vertically. No mirror symmetry, no conventional evenly balanced recurve with little ornaments. The dominant material is luminous sapphire-blue moonstone, opalescent translucent clear azure crystal and deep cobalt condensed moonlight. A visibly BLUE MOON is the central visual symbol. Noble brilliant blue edges and richly saturated dark-blue glasslike depth; subtle star engravings, thin pale-gold or platinum supporting seams only, no broad grey metal panels, not a steel bow painted blue. Rich sculptural jewelcraft, elegant open spaces, sharp yet flowing silhouette and controlled radiance. All elements form one coherently connected weapon. Keep the arrow path and string travel visually clear. No extra bow, no swords, staffs, arrows, people, hands, object stands, multiple angles, inset, collage, split panels, letters, labels, captions or background moon. A01. Make the UPPER limb visibly about 1.7 times the length and substantially wider than the LOWER limb. Place the grip below the vertical midpoint. Upper limb: an enormous graceful elongated moon-wing, three broad translucent sapphire ribs flowing upward into ONE long recurved tip, with a glowing crescent-shaped blue moonstone opening at its shoulder. Lower limb: a dramatically shorter, narrow deep-cobalt inward hook, only one sleek curve and tiny crystal fin, not a matching wing. One taut string connects the two tip notches. The long sweeping upper wing and compact hook below create the immediately unmistakable asymmetric outline. Sparse extremely refined platinum edge stitching, no loose dangling jewelry.

visual_qa.method: generatedImage and local view_image(original), each image separately inspected
visual_qa.note: 상부에 길고 넓은 세 갈래 달날개, 하부에는 짧고 가는 갈고리. 손잡이가 아래로 치우쳐 상하 길이와 부피 차이가 분명하다.
visual_qa.composition_note: 상하 끝 잘림 없음. 5% 안전여백을 프롬프트에 명시했으나 실제로는 일부 끝이 더 가까워 여백 조건은 완전히 따르지 않음. 원본은 편집하지 않고 보존.
